[[File:Ellie.png|thumb|250px|Ellie]] '''Ellie''' (Japanese: '''エリー''' ''Ellie'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW113|The Light of Floccesy Ranch!]]''. Ellie was searching for one of her lost {{p|Mareep}} when she met {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. After finding it, she took them to [[Floccesy Ranch]] where she works along with her grandfather [[Travon]]. She owns multiple Mareep, which help her with the work on the farm. Her {{p|Ampharos}} is in charge of the Mareep but it was very timid which caused it to have trouble handling them. Ellie decided to have it learn {{m|Thunder Punch}} to avoid the timidness but Ampharos had trouble using it. {{an|Iris}} had her {{TP|Iris|Dragonite}} train with Ampharos to help it learn Thunder Punch. When {{TRT}} took one of her Mareep, Ellie and the group searched for the missing Mareep but were not successful. They returned to the ranch when it became foggy, only for Ampharos to stay behind. Ellie found the source of the missing Mareep when {{AP|Pikachu}} and {{TP|Iris|Axew}} found Ampharos, which was an electric beam coming from Team Rocket's machine. She battled Team Rocket for a short time and after Pikachu's {{m|Thunderbolt}} and the machine were at full power, her Ampharos and Mareep separated due to the blast. As Team Rocket found the Pokémon first, Ampharos used its lights to get Ellie and the group. With Ellie and Iris's Dragonite's support, Ampharos was ultimately able to master Thunder Punch and defeat Team Rocket.
